\newcommand{\SVGFill}[2]{%
  \pgfsetfillcolor{#1}%
  \pgfpathsvg{#2}%
  \pgfusepath{fill}%
}

\newcommand{\SVGStroke}[3]{%
  \pgfsetstrokecolor{#1}%
  \pgfsetlinewidth{#2}%
  \pgfsetroundcap%
  \pgfsetroundjoin%
  \pgfpathsvg{#3}%
  \pgfusepath{stroke}%
}
